name: teamflow
description: TeamFlow – projektové řízení pro menší softwarové týmy

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @teamflow/shared" "npm run dev -w @teamflow/api" "npm run dev -w @teamflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @teamflow/api && npm run build -w @teamflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
